about_the_game:
Get behind the wheel of some of the most extreme examples of high-performance cars ever raced in the GTE Decade Pack and battle it out in one of the most thrilling and competitive classes in GT racing history.

Get into your favourite ride from elite brands such as Aston Martin and more, and strap-in for intense Balance of Performance racing action from a fabled era in GT racing.

This pack contains the following cars:

  • 2020 Aston Martin AMR Vantage GTE

  • 2020 BMW M8 GTE

  • 2017 Chevrolet Corvette C7.R

  • 2020 Chevrolet Corvette C8.R

  • 2017 Ford GT LM GTE

  • 2020 Porsche 911 RSR

...and more!
